label: digit 3 at original positions 3-6 in sequences starting with s
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.02% of steps). It fires only in the original phase at t=3..6 (peak t=4, then t=5), plus a small amount (4% of mass) on the <DEL> step of short sequences. It never fires in the copy phase. Two factors drive it: the first original token is s (83% of mass, 23x lift), and the current input is the digit 3 (66% of mass, 18x lift). The largest activations (top 12, up to max 3.05) are all input 3 at step 4 or 5 in s-initial sequences whose middle tokens come from {1,u,n,f,c,q} (e.g. s 1 u f [3]). Weaker activations land on other tokens at the same positions in s-initial sequences, and a few on 3 when the first token is m or p. The predicate s-first AND input 3 AND t in 3..6 reaches dev precision 0.25, recall 0.32, mass recall 0.50. Requiring only s-first at t 3..6 recovers 83% of mass, but precision is under 2%. The feature does NOT fire at t<3, at t>=8, or in the copy phase, and it fires on very few s-initial 3s at t=3 or t=6. Which intermediate tokens appear seems to gate it, but that part is not captured cleanly.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=s (+7.14), prev_tok=f (+4.58), prev_tok=c (+3.93), orig0=m (+3.38), prev_tok=n (+3.12), t=4 (+2.46). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-3.67), t=7 (-2.57), phase=2 (-2.30), orig2=t (-2.15).
